content:
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp System time of event creation.
ContextProcessId
UPID of process originating this event.
ContextThreadId
UTID of thread originating this event
TreeId
If this event is part of a detection tree, the tree ID it is part of.
TargetProcessId
The unique ID of a target process (in decimal, non-hex format). This field exists in almost all events, and it represents the ID of the process
that is responsible for the activity of the event in focus. For example, the TargetProcessId of a process that performed thread injection in
an InjectedThread event
RawProcessId
The operating system’s internal PID. For matching, use the UPID fields which guarantee a unique process identifier
ExitCode
A ULongHex field which is the exit code for a process.
KernelTime
UserTime
The total time executed in user mode. This field is in 100-nanosecond units.
CycleTime
A ULong64Hex field which is the number of number of processor clock cycles used.
MaxThreadCount
ConHostId
The raw process ID of the Conhost.exe (console host process) associated with this process. The PID is zero if no such host exists.
ConHostProcessId
